[[File:Signal_Scrambler_OAAI.png|thumb|right|250px|A signal scrambler affixed to a stone outcropping on [[Arda I]]]]
'''Signal scramblers'''' were devices that prevented others from tracking the sources of transmissions in the area.

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] used several to hide his [[Fulminiss's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], only a week before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] constructed and gifted a signal scrambler device to his friend, [[Pala Kwi'teksa]], to protect her from [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], against whom both children had conspired to rescue from her clutches several [[Ghostling]] children, whom Gardulla had kidnapped to use as ornaments in her luxurious if notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]].<ref>''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''; [[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]; [[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]; [[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>

[[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing's]] [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] had a sophisticated signal scrambler used to encode outgoing transmissions as part of its communications bay. The signals made it impossible to intercept and decode the transmissions.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Security scanner/Legends|Security scanners]] used scramblers to mask transmissions between the unit to nearby recording devices.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
